trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: يَا صَانِعَ كُلِّ مَصْنُوْعٍ وَيَا جَابِرَ كُلِّ كَسِيْرٍ وَيَا شَاهِدَ كُلِّ نَجْوٰى وَيَا رَبَّاهُ وَيَا سَيِّدَاهُ اَنْتَ النُّوْرُ فَوْقَ النُّوْرِ(وَنُوْرُ كُلِّ نُوْرٍ فَيَا نُوْرَ كُلِّ نُوْرٍ) فَيَا نُوْرَ النُّوْرِ وَيَا نُوْرَ كُلِّ نُوْرٍ اَسْئَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِيْ ذُنُوْبَ اللَّيْلِ وَذُنُوْبَ النَّهَارِ وَذُنُوْبَ السِّرِّ وَذُنُوْبَ الْعَلَانِيَةِ يَا قَادِرُ يَا قَدِيْرُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا اَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا وَدُوْدُ يَا غَفُوْرُ يَا رَحِيْمُ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA SAANE-A’ KULLE MAZNOO-I’N WA YAA JAABERA KULLE KASEE-RIN WA YAA SHAAHEDA KULLE NAJWAA WA YAA RABBAA-HO WA YAA SAYYEDA-HO ANTAN NOORO FAWQAN NOORE (WA NOORO KULLE NOORIN FA-YAA NOORA KULLE NOORIN) FA-YAA NOORAN NOORE WA YAA NOORA KULLE NOORIN AS-ALOKA BE-HAQQE MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN AN TO-SALLE-YA A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA AN TAGH-FERA LEE ZONOO-BAL LAIY-LE WA ZONOO-BAN NAHAA-RE WA ZONOO-BAS SIRRE WA ZONOO-BAL A’LAANE-YATE YAA QAADERO YAA WAAHEDO YAA AHADO YAA SAMADO YAA WADOODO YAA GHAFOORO YAA RAHEEMO.

trans.en: O Creator of all things that are created! O He who mends all broken bones! O He who clearly sees all that is whispered! O Nourisher! O my Master! You are Light upon light! You are Light of all lights. O Light of all lights! I ask You for the sake of Muhammad and his Progeny, to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny I ask You to forgive the sins I have committed at night or in daytime, sins done in private and sins done in public O the Powerful! O Almighty! O the Only! O the One! O Eternal, Absolute! O the All-Forgiving! O Merciful!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: يَا غَافِرَ الذَّنْۢبِ وَيَا قَابِلَ التَّوْبِ شَدِيْدَ الْعِقَابِ ذَا الطَّوْلِ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ تُحْيِيْ وَتُمِيْتُ وَتُمِيْتُ وَتُحْيِيْ وَاَنْتَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ وَارْحَمْنِيْ وَاعْفُ عَنِّيْ وَارْحَمْنِيْ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيْمُ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA GHAAFE-RAZ ZAMBE WA YAA QAABE-LAT TAWBE SHADEE-DAL E’KAABE ZAT-TAWLE LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA WAH-DAKA LAA SHAREE-KA LAKA TOH-YEE WA TOMEE-TO WA TOMEE-TO WA TOH-YEE WA ANTAL WAAHE-DUL QAH-HAARO SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WAGH-FIR LEE WAR HAMNEE WA’FO A’NNEE WAR HAMNEE INNA-KA ANTAR RAHMAA-NUR RAHEEMO.

trans.en: O Forgiver of sins, O Acceptor of repentance, O Strict in punishment, O Lord of Bestowals There is no God but You. You are the Only who has no associate. You give life and cause to die. You cause to die and give life You are the Only! The Subduer! Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny forgive me and have mercy on me, and Pardon me as You are Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
